full_name: Bettina M. Voelker | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Bettina M. Voelker, associate professor in the Department of Chemistry and Geochemistry at the Colorado School of Mines, studies chemical processes regulating the composition of natural waters.
